name: Albania
description: Albania from the Illyrians and Skanderbeg's revolt to Ottoman rule, independence in 1912, Enver Hoxha's closed state and the opening after 1991.

checkpoints.name: Illyrians and Skanderbeg
checkpoints.note: Illyrian tribes, Greek colonies and Rome held the coast. In the 1400s Skanderbeg held off the Ottomans for twenty-five years.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman Albania
checkpoints.note: Albania was part of the Ottoman Empire for more than four centuries, and most Albanians became Muslim.

checkpoints.name: Independence and Hoxha
checkpoints.note: Albania declared independence in 1912, became a kingdom under Zog, was invaded by Italy and then ruled by Enver Hoxha's communists, cut off from the world.

checkpoints.name: An open country
checkpoints.note: Communism ended in 1991. After the crisis of 1997 Albania joined NATO in 2009 and applied to join the European Union.
